findings:
PRICES: all TRY incl. 20% KDV, checked 26-27 Oct 2026. Ozdisan lists prices excl. KDV, multiplied by 1.2 here. FX for conversions: TCMB selling rate 26.10.2026, USD 49.7627 / EUR 55.7542. Turkish shop prices track the exchange rate, so expect about +5-10% by late January 2027.

TOTALS (list as given = 116 logic chips, not ~95):
- Unit price x qty = 3,677 TL for the 74HC chips, plus 60 TL for the 555s.
- Real cash outlay is about 4,500 TL, because 74HC161, 74HC163 and 74HC688 come only as n11 lots (25 / 25 / 6 pcs, which gives about 37 spares). Add an ESTIMATED 300-600 TL shipping across 5-7 shops.
- Cheaper plan, about 3,300 TL (same lots, two substitutions):
  (a) 74HC154 -> 2x 74HC138 (saves about 190 TL; DIP 154 is obsolete anyway).
  (b) 74HC377 -> 2x 74HC163 per 8-bit register (saves about 980 TL). Wire /LOAD as the active-low clock enable, ENP/ENT=0, /CLR=1. 8 + 16 = 24 chips fit in one 25-piece 163 lot.
- Rule of thumb: ~100 74HC DIP chips cost 3,500-5,000 TL bought in Turkey, which is 12-17% of the 30,000 TL budget.

HARD TO FIND IN DIP IN TURKEY (none of these on the shelf at direnc / robotistan / motorobit / robotsepeti / Ozdisan / elektrovadi; Farnell-via-SAMM sold out):
- 74HC161, 163, 166, 173, 377, 688: only on n11, mostly old-stock lots (seller ackelektronik) or single pieces at 93-122 TL.
- 74HC154: DIP is OBSOLETE worldwide (TI CD74HC154E/EN, DigiKey 0 stock). direnc has 41 narrow-DIP pcs at 116 TL; Ozdisan has 2 pcs CD74HCT154E -> use 2x 74HC138.
- 74HC541: direnc has only 9 DIP (verified live 27.10).
- 74HC191: direnc has only 16.
- Thin or sold-out stock that varies by shop: 74HC283, 74HC86 (cheap ones sold out), 74HC175 (Ozdisan 57).
- LMC555 / ICM7555: not found; TLC555CP is easy (motorobit 566 pcs).
SUBSTITUTES:
- HCT parts work alongside HC at 5 V: HC outputs drive HCT inputs fine and HCT outputs are full CMOS swing. CD74HCT541E, PC74HCT688P and CD74HCT138E are cheaper or the only stock.
- 74HC245 with DIR tied (12.20 TL, 1788 pcs at direnc) = 74HC541.
- 74HC244 (direnc 15.11, supplier stock) = 541 with a different pinout.
- 74HC257 (Ozdisan 39.61 incl. KDV, 4719 pcs) = 157 with /OE tied low.
- 74HC174 (direnc 18.71) = 175 if Q-bar is not needed.
- 74HC165 = 166, but its parallel load is asynchronous, so time the load pulse away from the shift clock edge.
- 2x 74HC163 = 74HC377.
- 74HC163 or 74HC377 = 74HC173 if no tri-state output is needed.

IMPORT VS LOCAL: buy locally. Importing does not pay off for logic chips.
- Customs: the 30 EUR duty-free allowance for post/express parcels ended (Presidential Decision 10813, Resmi Gazete 7 Jan 2026, in force about 6 Feb 2026). Consultancy and press sources (lires.com.tr, Hurriyet) give flat 30% for EU origin and 60% for non-EU (US, China), plus declaration ('sunum') and broker fees. One source (ideasoft) says ordinary goods now go through a full declaration at per-GTIP rates instead (ICs 8542 = 0% duty + 20% KDV) plus broker fees. Treat this as unresolved; the fixed fees apply either way.
- Real-world 2026 complaints (sikayetvar, AliExpress): extra customs/broker demands of about 3,900-5,600 TL on small parcels via PTT / gnd Global.
- Mouser Turkey: FCA terms, duties and taxes paid by you on delivery; free shipping over about 60 EUR / $100.
- DigiKey Turkey terms could not be verified (site blocks fetches; ESTIMATE: similar free-shipping threshold, duties paid on delivery).
- Worked example, all ~116 chips from DigiKey/Mouser (about $105 = 5,200 TL): +60% = about 8,350 TL, plus broker fees -> 8,500-13,000 TL, versus about 4,500 TL locally.
- LCSC: cheaper parts (Lingxing/HGSEMI clones $0.14-0.31, TI $0.5-1.6) but several DIP parts are out of stock (TI 377, 541, 191, 166, 161; 74 sold out). DHL shipping ESTIMATE $20-35, then 60% -> still worse than local.
- Even adding only the expensive-locally chips (377, 166, 173, 688, about $20) to an import order you place anyway (e.g. for SRAM or the 25.175 MHz oscillator) roughly breaks even (about 1,600 TL vs 1,566 TL locally), so it is not worth the delay or risk.
- If importing anyway, an EU-origin seller (TME Poland: SN74HC688N 265 pcs about $1.70; Farnell) gets 30% instead of 60%.

FAKE / REFURB RISK:
- Ozdisan (authorized TI/Nexperia distributor) and DigiKey/Mouser: genuine.
- direnc / robotistan / motorobit / robotsepeti: mostly STM/TI or Chinese second-source brands (Hgsemi, Xblw, HTC). Second-source chips are legitimate and fine for 1-2 MHz.
- n11 ackelektronik lots carry discontinued brands (Philips, Motorola, Harris), so they are old new-old-stock or possibly pulls: expect old date codes and oxidized legs. Fine on breadboard, but test every chip on arrival (the TL866II+/T48 programmer has a 74xx logic-test mode, or use an Arduino tester).
- AliExpress 74HC lots: higher remark risk, and now the same customs exposure. Avoid.

WHERE TO BUY (fewest parcels):
- direnc.net: 02, 14, 32, 74, 139, 157, 164, 191, 273, 541 (9), 595, 245, NE555; 154 only if not substituting.
- motorobit: 00, 193, 245, 283, TLC555 (also 153 at 30.30).
- robotistan: 08, 138, 153.
- robotsepeti: 04, 86.
- Ozdisan: SN74HC574N (genuine TI, 1777 pcs), 74HC175N; also the genuine-TI fallback for 04/08/14/74/138/139/164/245.
- n11: 74HC161 lot, MC74HC163 lot, PC74HCT688P lot, 74HC166, 74HC173, 74HC377 (or skip 377 via 2x163).
Order in Nov-Dec 2026, before the late-Jan build start, because several listings are the last lot or low stock (161 lot, HCT688 lot, 541, 191). Buy 10-20% spares.
